answer: An AI-agent economy can curb Sybil attacks via witnessed thermal attestation. Verifiers issue a pulsed compute challenge while a local witness emits an ultrasonic signal across the host's exhaust plume to a fixed reflector. Because hot air speeds acoustic propagation, transit-time shifts in the returning echo must match the load schedule. Attackers thus incur hardware, power, and space costs per identity, though stray HVAC drafts can distort readings and reject valid nodes.
